# CheckNumber Email Validation API
> Official integration context for the documented product.

## Canonical resources
- [email_check](https://docs.checknumber.ai/email-deliverability-checker/)

## Contract facts
- API base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
- Authentication: `X-API-Key` request header
- API key environment variable: `CHECKNUMBER_API_KEY`
- Processing mode: async_bulk
- Current prices are not embedded; use the official pricing page.

## Products
- `email_check`: Upload Task · input `email` · fields: email, activated

## Safety
- Process only identifiers you are authorized to verify.
- Do not expose API keys in browser code or commit secrets.
- An undetermined result is not a confirmed negative.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.

## Upload and billing limits verified 2026-10-30

- `email_check`: upload 1–10,000,000 entries; minimum billable quantity 2,000.

Upload minimum and minimum billable quantity are different. A smaller accepted upload can still be billed at the stated minimum; a wholly failed task with zero processed entries is not charged a minimum. A billable quantity of 0 means no billing floor. Check current pricing before submitting.
